title: Zhaozhou's Bridge
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett shared an experience where they gave a Dharma talk on the koan "Zhaozhou's donkey's cross," highlighting how our perceptions can change over time and how we can learn to let go of preconceptions. The story invites us to reflect on our own experiences and emotions, considering whether we're holding onto idealized expectations for others or ourselves, which can lead to feelings of inadequacy or frustration. By embracing our imperfections and limitations, we can find liberation from these expectations and cultivate a more authentic understanding of reality.
